name: United Credit Limited
about: United Credit Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides hire purchase, leasing, and other financial services in India. The company operates in two segments, Financing Activity and Renting Activity. It also engages in consumer financing, investment, and capital market operations. United Credit Limited was formerly known as United India Credit and Development Company Limited and changed its name to United Credit Limited in January 1981. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
